title: Management policy draft

policy_name.description: 1..100 plain text. Version immutable after release

product_profile_id.description: exact currency/quantity/trigger semantics. No share math for options

size_mode.description: supported released family. All modes bounded by hard limits

risk_budget.description: explicit approved currency/percentage unit. required for risk mode

fixed_units.description: legal positive step;hard-cap bound. required only fixed_units

fixed_notional.description: positive currency value. required only fixed_notional

stop_recipe_id.description: released compatible recipe. Null means stopless signal cannot be resolved without provider stop

target_policy_id.description: released role/partial/basis definitions. No invented provider target

trail_recipe_id.description: released non-loosening recipe. No trailing automatic activation by price default

holding_policy_id.description: finite applicable strategy/product deadlines. Includes session coverage

apply_to.description: existing allocations require separate transition. No silent retrofit

description: Ready-input schema plus server business validation. Draft input uses identical property types but permits missing required fields; missingness must be displayed. Identity/password forms never saved as drafts.
